description: This file defines a serializer (GuidCodec) for the Guid type within the Orleans.Serialization framework, handling serialization and deserialization of Guid objects to a wire format.

classes.name: GuidCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec<Guid>, responsible for serializing and deserializing Guid objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Guid value with type information.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Guid value without type information, optimized for known expected type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Guid value from the input, ensuring the length prefix matches expected size.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw bytes of a Guid to the buffer, optimized for system endianness and runtime version.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw bytes from the input and constructs a Guid, handling endianness and buffer access.
